command:
set -eu
. /etc/os-release
printf '%s:%s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"
test "$ID" = rhel
case "$VERSION_ID" in 9|9.*) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
test "$(getenforce)" = Enforcing
systemctl is-active sshd.service
systemctl is-enabled sshd.service

set -eu
getent passwd opsadmin | cut -d: -f1,3,4,5,6,7
getent passwd contractor | cut -d: -f1,3,4,5,6,7
getent group ssh-access
id opsadmin
id contractor
id -nG opsadmin | tr ' ' '\n' | grep -qx ssh-access
! id -nG contractor | tr ' ' '\n' | grep -qx ssh-access

set -eu
test "$(cat /home/opsadmin/prepared-state.txt)" = 'prepared opsadmin state: preserve'
test "$(cat /home/contractor/prepared-state.txt)" = 'prepared contractor state: preserve'
fixture_key="$(cat /var/lib/infraset-ssh-fixture/access-key.pub)"
for file in /root/.ssh/authorized_keys /home/opsadmin/.ssh/authorized_keys /home/contractor/.ssh/authorized_keys; do
  grep -qxF "$fixture_key" "$file"
  stat -c '%U:%G:%a:%n' "$file"
done
actual_shadow_checksum="$({
  getent shadow opsadmin | cut -d: -f1,2
  getent shadow contractor | cut -d: -f1,2
} | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)"
test "$actual_shadow_checksum" = "$(cat /var/lib/infraset-ssh-fixture/shadow.sha256)"

set -eu
. /etc/os-release
printf '%s:%s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"
test "$ID" = almalinux
case "$VERSION_ID" in 9|9.*) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
id sshprobe
test -s /home/sshprobe/.ssh/id_ed25519
test -s /home/sshprobe/.ssh/known_hosts
test -x /home/sshprobe/.ssh/askpass
ssh-keygen -lf /home/sshprobe/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub

set -eu
. /etc/os-release
printf '%s:%s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"
test "$ID" = almalinux
case "$VERSION_ID" in 9|9.*) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
id sshprobe
test -s /home/sshprobe/.ssh/id_ed25519
test -s /home/sshprobe/.ssh/known_hosts
ssh-keygen -lf /home/sshprobe/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub

set -eu
for user in opsadmin contractor root; do
  runuser -u sshprobe -- ssh \
    -o BatchMode=yes \
    -o IdentitiesOnly=yes \
    -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes \
    -o UserKnownHostsFile=/home/sshprobe/.ssh/known_hosts \
    -i /home/sshprobe/.ssh/id_ed25519 \
    "$user@node1" 'printf "%s:%s\n" "$(id -un)" "$(hostname -s)"'
done

set -eu
runuser -u sshprobe -- ssh \
  -o BatchMode=yes \
  -o IdentitiesOnly=yes \
  -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes \
  -o UserKnownHostsFile=/home/sshprobe/.ssh/known_hosts \
  -i /home/sshprobe/.ssh/id_ed25519 \
  opsadmin@node1 'printf "%s:%s\n" "$(id -un)" "$(hostname -s)"'
